name: Object-Order Empty Space Skipping
aliases: Front-to-back ray-casting with bounding box culling
GPU-based Ray-Casting with Object-Order Empty Space Skipping
definition: A ray-casting technique that stores the volume in a 3D texture and drives a fragment program to cast rays. It uses object-order empty space skipping via block min-max values to reduce overhead, adaptive sampling to handle silhouette quality, and iterative bisection for intersection refinement.
summary: Object-Order Empty Space Skipping is a GPU-based volume rendering optimization that uses block min-max metadata and rasterized bounding geometry to skip inactive regions, differing from image-order methods by computing ray bounds via active block geometry.
